title: A Aftermath for the Interior
author: Ada Reyes
blurb: Marguerite Dunmore, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
